text_en: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen a member of the court of Herod the ruler, and Saul.
text_cn: 在安提约基雅教会中，有一些先知和教师，其中有巴尔纳伯和号称尼革尔的西满，有基勒乃人路基约，和与分封侯黑落德同乳的玛纳恒，还有扫禄。

text_en: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them. ”
text_cn: 他们敬礼主和禁食的时候，圣神向他们说：“你们给我选拔出巴尔纳伯和扫禄来，去行我叫他们要行的工作。”

text_en: Then after fasting and praying they laid their hands on them and sent them off.
text_cn: 他们遂禁食祈祷，给他们覆了手，派他们走了。

text_en: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia; and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
text_cn: 二人既被圣神派遣，遂下到色娄基雅，又从那里乘船往塞浦路斯。

text_en: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. And they had John also to assist them.
text_cn: 他们来到撒拉米，就在犹太人的会堂中，宣讲天主的圣道；还有若望作助手。

text_en: When they had gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they met a certain magician, a Jewish false prophet, named Bar-Jesus.
text_cn: 他们走遍了全岛，直到帕佛，遇见一个犹太人，他是个术士，也是假先知，名叫巴尔耶稣，

text_en: He was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man, who summoned Barnabas and Saul and wanted to hear the word of God.
text_cn: 他常同色尔爵保禄总督在一起；总督是个聪明人，他邀请了巴尔纳伯和扫禄来，想听天主的圣道；

text_en: But the magician Elymas (for that is the translation of his name) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
text_cn: 但那术士厄吕玛──这是他的希腊译名──却反对他们，想法颠覆总督的信心。

text_en: But Saul, also known as Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked intently at him
text_cn: 扫禄，也即是保禄，充满了圣神，定睛望着他，

text_en: and said, “You son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, full of all deceit and villainy, will you not stop making crooked the straight paths of the Lord?
text_cn: 说：“你这满怀各种欺诈和各种奸恶的人，魔鬼的儿子，一切正义的仇敌，你还不停止颠覆天主的正道吗？

text_en: And now listen—the hand of the Lord is against you, and you will be blind for a while, unable to see the sun. ” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he went about groping for someone to lead him by the hand.
text_cn: 现今你看，上主的手要临于你，你要变成一个瞎子，看不见太阳，直到一个时期。”立刻昏黑和幽暗降在他身上，他就来回摸索，找寻领路的人。

text_en: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
text_cn: 那时，总督看见发生的事就信了，很惊讶主的道理。

text_en: Then Paul and his companions set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John, however, left them and returned to Jerusalem;
text_cn: 以后，保禄和同他一起的人，从帕佛乘船来到旁非里雅的培尔革；若望却离开他们，回了耶路撒冷。

text_en: but they went on from Perga and came to Antioch in Pisidia. And on the sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.
text_cn: 他们由培尔革经过各处，到了丕息狄雅的安提约基雅；安息日他们进了会堂坐下。

text_en: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the officials of the synagogue sent them a message, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, give it. ”
text_cn: 在朗诵《法律》和《先知》之后，会堂长派人问他们说：“仁人弟兄，你们若有什么劝勉民众的话，请说罢！”

text_en: So Paul stood up and with a gesture began to speak: “You Israelites, and others who fear God, listen.
text_cn: 保禄就站起来，打手势说：“诸位以色列人和敬畏天主的人，请听！

text_en: The God of this people Israel chose our ancestors and made the people great during their stay in the land of Egypt, and with uplifted arm he led them out of it.
text_cn: 以色列民族的天主，拣选了我们的祖先。当这百姓寄居埃及时，天主就举扬了他们，以大能的手臂从那里领他们出来。

text_en: For about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
text_cn: 大约四十年的工夫在旷野中容忍了他们。

text_en: After he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land as an inheritance
text_cn: 灭了在客纳罕地方的七个民族以后，就把那地方分给他们作为基业，

text_en: for about four hundred fifty years. After that he gave them judges until the time of the prophet Samuel.
text_cn: 约有四百五十年。此后，又给他们立了民长，直到撒慕尔先知时代。

text_en: Then they asked for a king; and God gave them Saul son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, who reigned for forty years.
text_cn: 从那时起，他们要求一位君王，天主就给他们立了本雅明族人克士的儿子撒乌耳，为王四十年；

text_en: When he had removed him, he made David their king. In his testimony about him he said, ‘I have found David, son of Jesse, to be a man after my heart, who will carry out all my wishes. ’
text_cn: 把他撤职以后，给他们立了达味为君王，天主为他作证说：我找到了叶瑟的儿子达味，他是一个合我心意的人，他要履行我的一切旨意。

text_en: Of this man’s posterity God has brought to Israel a Savior, Jesus, as he promised;
text_cn: 天主按照恩许，从他的后裔中给以色列兴起了一位救主耶稣。

text_en: before his coming John had already proclaimed a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
text_cn: 若翰在他来临以前，先向全以色列民宣讲了悔改的洗礼。

text_en: And as John was finishing his work, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. No, but one is coming after me; I am not worthy to untie the thong of the sandals on his feet. ’
text_cn: 及至若翰将完成自己的任务时，说道：我不是你们所猜想的那位，但是，看，他在我以后要来，我不配解他脚上的鞋。

text_en: “My brothers, you descendants of Abraham’s family, and others who fear God, to us the message of this salvation has been sent.
text_cn: 诸位仁人弟兄，亚巴郎的子孙和你们敬畏天主的人！这救恩之道正是给我们赐下的，

text_en: Because the residents of Jerusalem and their leaders did not recognize him or understand the words of the prophets that are read every sabbath, they fulfilled those words by condemning him.
text_cn: 因为耶路撒冷的居民和他们的首领不认识他，也不明白每安息日所诵读的先知的预言，就判决了他，而应验了这些预言。

text_en: Even though they found no cause for a sentence of death, they asked Pilate to have him killed.
text_cn: 他们本来找不到一条死罪，却要求比拉多处死了他。

text_en: When they had carried out everything that was written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
text_cn: 论他所记载的都成就了以后，就把他从木架上卸下，放在坟墓里，

text_en: But God raised him from the dead;
text_cn: 天主却使他从死者中复活起来，

text_en: and for many days he appeared to those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, and they are now his witnesses to the people.
text_cn: 他多日显现给同他一起，从加里肋亚往耶路撒冷去的人；这些人就是现今在百姓前给他作证的人。

text_en: And we bring you the good news that what God promised to our ancestors
text_cn: 我们现今也给你们报告喜讯：就是那向祖先所应许的恩许，

text_en: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising Jesus; as also it is written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son; today I have begotten you. ’
text_cn: 天主已给我们作他们子孙的完成了，叫耶稣复活了，就如在第二篇《圣咏》上所记载的：‘你是我的儿子，我今日生了你。’

text_en: As to his raising him from the dead, no more to return to corruption, he has spoken in this way, ‘I will give you the holy promises made to David. ’
text_cn: 论到天主使他从死者中复活了，使他不再归于腐朽，曾这样说过：‘我要赐给你们许与达味的圣善忠实。’

text_en: Therefore he has also said in another psalm, ‘You will not let your Holy One experience corruption. ’
text_cn: 为此，又在另一处说：‘你决不让你的圣者见到腐朽。’

text_en: For David, after he had served the purpose of God in his own generation, died, was laid beside his ancestors, and experienced corruption;
text_cn: 达味固然在自己活着时，奉行了天主的旨意，但是他死了，也归到了自己祖先那里，且见到了腐朽；

text_en: but he whom God raised up experienced no corruption.
text_cn: 但天主从死者中所复活的那位，却没有见到腐朽。

text_en: Let it be known to you therefore, my brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you;
text_cn: 所以，诸位仁人弟兄，你们必须知道：就是藉着这耶稣给你们宣布了赦罪之恩；凡在一切你们凭梅瑟法律不能成义的事上，

text_en: by this Jesus everyone who believes is set free from all those sins from which you could not be freed by the law of Moses.
text_cn: 凭着他，凡信的人都可成义。

text_en: Beware, therefore, that what the prophets said does not happen to you:
text_cn: 所以，你们要小心，不要叫《先知书》上说的话来到你们身上：

text_en: ‘Look, you scoffers! Be amazed and perish, for in your days I am doing a work, a work that you will never believe, even if someone tells you. ’”
text_cn: ‘藐视的人哪！你们要看，要惊讶，要消逝！因为在你们的日子，我作了一件事，即使有人告诉你们，你们也必不信那件事。’”

text_en: As Paul and Barnabas were going out, the people urged them to speak about these things again the next sabbath.
text_cn: 他们出去的时候，众人要求下一个安息日再给他们讲这些事。

text_en: When the meeting of the synagogue broke up, many Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
text_cn: 会众散去以后，有许多犹太人和归依犹太教的虔诚人，随从了保禄和巴尔纳伯，二人同他们谈话，劝他们务要坚持天主的恩宠。

text_en: The next sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
text_cn: 下一个安息日，全城的人几乎都聚集了来，要听天主的圣道。

text_en: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy; and blaspheming, they contradicted what was spoken by Paul.
text_cn: 犹太人一看见这么众多的人，就满心嫉妒，反对保禄所讲的，且加以辱骂。

text_en: Then both Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, saying, “It was necessary that the word of God should be spoken first to you. Since you reject it and judge yourselves to be unworthy of eternal life, we are now turning to the Gentiles.
text_cn: 保禄和巴尔纳伯却放胆地说：“天主的圣道本来先应讲给你们听，但因你们拒而不受，并断定自己不配得永生，看，我们就要转向外邦人，

text_en: For so the Lord has commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you to be a light for the Gentiles, so that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth. ’”
text_cn: 因为主如此命我们说：‘我已立你作为外邦人的光明，使你成为他们的救恩，直到地极。’”

text_en: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and praised the word of the Lord; and as many as had been destined for eternal life became believers.
text_cn: 外邦人听了，都很喜欢，赞美主的圣道；那些被预定获得永生的人，就都信了。

text_en: Thus the word of the Lord spread throughout the region.
text_cn: 主的圣道遂传遍了那地方。

text_en: But the Jews incited the devout women of high standing and the leading men of the city, and stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of their region.
text_cn: 犹太人却挑唆敬畏天主的尊贵妇人和城中的要人，发动迫害保禄和巴尔纳伯，把他们驱逐出境。

text_en: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them, and went to Iconium.
text_cn: 二人就把脚上的尘土向他们拂下，往依科尼雍去了。

text_en: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 门徒都充满喜乐和圣神。
